label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User input from request.getParameter(BenchmarkTest01262) flows through doSomething() to bar variable. While the code strips the last character via substring(), the remaining content is still attacker-controlled and written directly to HTTP response without HTML encoding. Converting to char array does not sanitize XSS payloads. X-XSS-Protection: 0 header explicitly disables browser XSS filters, making this a confirmed XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User parameter flows to bar and printed to response without HTML encoding
